{{Quote|I am a member of the Zssik clan. Perhaps you have heard of my clan? Or perhaps you haven't? It matters very little either way. All you really need to know is that we are tired of having to be subservient to those Blackscale weaklings. It is time for us to take our rightful place as rulers of the Avatar.|Boshaz, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:RotW">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''</ref>}}
The '''Zssik Clan''' was a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaving]] family that operated out of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] homeworld of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. They bristled under the control of the dominant [[Blackscale Clan/Legends|Blackscale Clan's]] organization, and plotted to seize power in a series of meticulously planned operations designed to undermine the Blackscales and make them appear incompetent in the eyes of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], even going so far as to provide the Wookiee resistance with the access codes for the [[Avatar Orbital Platform]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Zssik Clan appeared in the video game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Star Wars video games#Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.
